name: Honcho
description: An unofficial native Debian 13 AMD64 Proxmox LXC adaptation of Honcho using PostgreSQL + pgvector, Redis, Python, and systemd without a nested application container runtime.

notes.text: Development status: the real-Proxmox runtime matrix has not yet been marked complete. Do not treat the development branch as a runtime-certified release.
The LXC is unprivileged. nesting=1 is enabled for Debian 13/Systemd LXC compatibility; keyctl remains disabled. Honcho does not use Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or another nested application runtime.
Honcho requires an LLM provider. The installer supports OpenAI direct and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint mode.
The API listens on port 8000. PostgreSQL and Redis remain local services inside the container.
